training.difficultyDesc.cadet: Assisted training: clearer sensors, easier firing solutions, reduced enemy damage and lower resource consumption.
training.difficultyDesc.hardcore: No concessions: less certain contacts, historically less reliable torpedoes, more efficient enemies and harsher damage.
training.difficultyDesc.officer: Recommended balance: complete rules, operational guidance and calibrated parameters without removing simulation depth.
training.difficultyDesc.simulator: Stricter parameters, less sensor assistance and more realistic resource consumption.
training.help.ai: This board shows enemy confidence, attack solution, escorts, aircraft and launched charges. Do not wait for damage: react as the enemy solution begins to rise.
training.help.command: Use this station to follow objectives, select doctrine and access the periscope. Before attacking, observe; after firing, lower the mast, dive and select evasion.
training.help.damage: Close watertight doors, enable pumps and assign teams to the correct compartment. Fire, flooding, power and casualties require different tasks and worsen over time.
training.help.instruments: Ordered depth and engine order are not the actual values. Watch needles, vertical speed, ballast, trim, battery, oxygen, noise and cavitation.
training.help.navigation: Use heading, rudder, autopilot, route and time compression. Compression is reduced automatically during danger, damage, mast exposure or torpedo travel.
training.help.sensors: The hydrophone is passive and discreet. Active sonar and radar provide better data but reveal your position. Check bearing, confidence, age and trend before attacking.
training.help.weapons: Synchronize the TDC with a valid contact and check speed, course, AOB, run depth, tube and firing arc. A marginal solution may miss even without a torpedo defect.
training.helpAction.ai: If enemy confidence exceeds 45%, reduce noise, change depth and prepare countermeasures before the attack.
training.helpAction.command: Safe sequence: observe → calculate → attack → lower periscope → dive → silent running → disengage.
training.helpAction.damage: Priority: fire and critical flooding, then power, repairs and medical care.
training.helpAction.instruments: Avoid high speed at shallow depth around escorts: noise and cavitation increase detection.
training.helpAction.navigation: Plan the approach before contact. Use high compression only while clear of threats.
training.helpAction.sensors: Prefer hydrophone for search; use active sonar only when an immediate solution justifies the exposure.
training.helpAction.weapons: Do not fire merely because the button is available. Wait for a good solution and a firing arc compatible with the selected tube.

captainExecution.effect.fireConfirm: Fire order transmitted. Torpedo launched and escorts may react.
captainExecution.effect.periscopeDepth: Depth planes acknowledged; submarine rising to allow observation and safe launch.
captainExecution.effect.openPeriscope: Periscope raised to confirm target, range, course and exposure risk.
captainExecution.effect.cancelAttack: Attack suspended; periscope lowered and contact will be shadowed silently.
captainExecution.effect.holdShadow: Executive officer keeps contact by listening without revealing position.
captainExecution.effect.authorizeRepair: Chief mechanic and damage party authorized; priority is hull, power and crew.
captainExecution.effect.evadeNow: Crew dives, cuts noise and tries to break the enemy solution.
captainExecution.effect.emergencyDive: Dive alarm; depth control takes a rapid descent.
captainExecution.effect.silentRunning: Engines reduced and chatter cut; passive sonar becomes priority.
captainExecution.effect.silentApproach: Slow pace, passive listening and target shadowing to gain a solution.
captainExecution.effect.planPatrol: Navigator plots the sector route so the captain avoids micromanagement.
captainExecution.effect.stopBoat: Engines stopped to reduce noise, repair or wait for contact.
captainExecution.effect.slowSpeed: Engines at low RPM to balance control, noise and observation.
captainExecution.effect.shallowUp: Controlled rise to relieve pressure or prepare observation.
captainExecution.effect.levelTrim: Trim leveled to stabilize depth and reduce oscillation.
captainExecution.effect.manual: Manual mode active: the player directly controls stations, helm, depth and weapons.
captainExecution.effect.blocked: The order was refused by current conditions; check depth, systems, torpedoes or contact.
captainChain.response.standby: Executive officer listening. No critical order in progress.
captainChain.response.manual: Manual control active. Crew observes but will not take automatic initiative.
captainChain.response.missionFailed: Command compromised. Crew is out of combat flow.
captainChain.response.objectiveDone: Main objective complete. Executive officer recommends ending or leaving the area.
captainChain.response.torpedoRunning: Torpedo in the water. Periscope holds bearing while all stations await impact or evasion.
captainChain.response.damageCritical: Chief mechanic reports critical damage. Attack or patrol must yield to damage control.
captainChain.response.escortThreat: Sonar reports escort closing a solution. Attack order conflicts with survival.
captainChain.response.tooDeep: Depth control reports current depth does not allow safe periscope confirmation.
captainChain.response.solutionPoor: TDC has no reliable solution yet. Weapons requests more time or a new bearing.
captainChain.response.needPeriscope: Periscope must confirm the target before any realistic launch.
captainChain.response.readyToFire: Tube/TDC ready. Executive officer asks: authorize firing, Captain?
captainChain.response.airThreat: Probable aircraft contact. Executive officer recommends immediate dive.
captainChain.response.noContact: No firm contact. Navigator recommends planned patrol instead of micromanagement.
captainChain.response.blocked: The order was not accepted under current conditions. Executive officer recommends reassessment.
captainChain.response.repairUnderway: Damage party is working. Chief mechanic reports progress and asks for operational protection.
captainChain.response.evasionAcknowledge: Evasion acknowledged. Sonar tracks threat while engines cut signature.
captainChain.response.contactHeld: Contact held by listening. Executive officer requests attack or shadow decision.
captainChain.response.orderAcknowledged: Order received and routed to the correct station.
combatCycle.panel.question: Question to captain
combatCycle.question.patrol: No firm contact. Order a planned patrol and wait for station reports?
combatCycle.question.manual: Manual mode active. The player operates directly; crew only reports the situation.
combatCycle.question.lost: Boat out of combat. There is no safe tactical cycle to continue.
combatCycle.question.complete: Objective complete. End mission or leave the area safely?
combatCycle.question.damage: Chief mechanic reports critical damage. Authorize damage control before any attack?
combatCycle.question.air: Executive officer reports probable air contact. Order emergency dive?
combatCycle.question.postShotEvade: Torpedo launched and escort reacting. Order immediate evasion?
combatCycle.question.postShotHold: Torpedo launched. Hold bearing and observe impact?
combatCycle.question.depth: Attack prepared, but depth prevents confirmation. Order periscope depth?
combatCycle.question.solution: Weapons is still calculating. Keep attack preparation?
combatCycle.question.visual: Solution building. Raise periscope for the captain final confirmation?
combatCycle.question.fire: Tube and TDC ready. Authorize firing, Captain?
combatCycle.question.fireWithEscort: Tube ready, but escort threatens. Fire now and evade?
combatCycle.question.escort: Escort is closing a solution. Break attack and evade?
combatCycle.question.attackOrShadow: Contact classified as target. Prepare attack or keep shadowing?
combatCycle.question.classify: Probable contact. Shadow until class and course are confirmed?
combatCycle.question.chain: Command chain already has a recommendation. Confirm the next order?
